This answers white-mage-s-staff's own open question for the case where the simplification's execution ALREADY EXISTS pre-migration: model the real consequence as real, evidenced vocabulary rather than force-fitting it into the inert-gap pattern just because a sibling with the SAME conceptual mismodel happened to leave its own version unwired.
